description: Repeat a wake-up call on your wake-up-calls plan: every N minutes (at least 5), hourly, daily or weekly at a time in a time zone. Each run comes with an idempotency_key (dedupe on it). A run that fails after every retry is missed 21 to 25 minutes after its time and puts one "missed" message in alert_inbox_instance_id (or the target inbox). Up to 10 per plan.

alert_inbox_instance_id.description: One of your inboxes for missed-run messages.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

payload.description: Any JSON object, up to 8 KB, sent with every run.

minutes.description: Minutes on the UTC clock: an N that divides a day (5, 15, 60, 1440) runs from 00:00 UTC.

minute.description: Every hour at this minute (0 to 59) of time_zone's clock.

at.description: Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.
Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.

url.description: A public https URL we POST to.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Istanbul. Default UTC.

name: schedule_create
title: Repeat a wake-up call
